mapper.select: select v from sys_config where k = #{key} limit 1

select s.id, s.class_id as classId, c.class_period as classPeriod, s.teacher_id as teacherId, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as teacherName, s.schedule_date as scheduleDate, s.course_detail_id as courseDetailId, d.stage_name as stageName, d.day_number as dayNumber, s.course_content as courseContent, s.class_type as classType from sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_class c on c.id = s.class_id left join sys_course_detail d on d.id = s.course_detail_id left join sys_user u on u.id = s.teacher_id where s.class_id = #{classId} and s.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_class_schedule (class_id, teacher_id, schedule_date, course_detail_id, course_content, class_type, created_at, updated_at) values
(#{item.classId}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.scheduleDate}, #{item.courseDetailId}, #{item.courseContent}, #{item.classType}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select d.stage_name as stageName, count(*) as stageNumber, min(s.schedule_date) as startDate, max(s.schedule_date) as endDate from sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_course_detail d on d.id = s.course_detail_id where s.class_id = #{classId} and s.class_type = 'CLASS' group by d.stage_name order by min(s.schedule_date), min(d.day_number), min(d.id)

select distinct u.id, coalesce(nullif(u.real_name, ''), nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as teacherName from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.role_code = 'TEACHER' order by u.id
select distinct teacher_id from sys_class_schedule where class_id != #{classId} and teacher_id is not null and class_type = 'CLASS' and schedule_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}

select count(distinct u.id) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where u.id = #{teacherId} and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.role_code = 'TEACHER'
select count(*) from sys_class_schedule where class_id != #{classId} and teacher_id = #{teacherId} and class_type = 'CLASS' and schedule_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
mapper.update: update sys_class_schedule s inner join sys_course_detail d on d.id = s.course_detail_id set s.teacher_id = #{teacherId}, s.updated_at = now() where s.class_id = #{classId} and s.class_type = 'CLASS' and d.stage_name = #{stageName}
mapper.select: select id, class_id as classId, teacher_id as teacherId, schedule_date as scheduleDate, course_detail_id as courseDetailId, course_content as courseContent, class_type as classType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from sys_class_schedule where class_id = #{classId} and schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}

mapper.select: select id, class_id as classId, teacher_id as teacherId, schedule_date as scheduleDate, course_detail_id as courseDetailId, course_content as courseContent, class_type as classType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from sys_class_schedule where class_id = #{classId} and schedule_date >= #{fromDate} and class_type = 'CLASS' order by schedule_date, id
